verdict.rationale: Datadog documents its own natural-language interface for querying infrastructure resources and telemetry data, so part of the story is delivered by the product itself. That evidence is a single index line covering only querying, not operating the product more broadly (creating monitors, dashboards, or taking actions). The MCP server and the coding-agent prompt belong to other stories or are user-side workarounds, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: natural-language commands beyond querying (configuring or acting on resources), in-depth first-party docs for the NL interface, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Query infrastructure resources and telemetry data using natural language or DDSQL syntax with support for tags as table columns.
